score_method: Minimum mandatory visual-area score, not an average. A mandatory inconsistency blocks approval.

areas.finding: Short square open timber X-braced pedestal on pale stone base matches sourceB048 appearance. Authored blue band/snow/toolbox/crate details are clearly a static interpretation; it is distinct from the earlier enclosed tower.
Warm sculpted timber, blue metal, bronze fasteners, pale cut stone, clean snow and soft studio shadows fit the approved ballista/fence language.

Six complete distinct panels: front identified by step/front orange tab, right by repair box/handle, rear by supply crate, left by blank service face with front-step edge to image-right, overhead and elevated front-right three-quarter.

Overhead fixes deck plank long axes left–right across the front, and the three-quarter image agrees. Both RIGHT and LEFT cardinal panels instead draw the deck boards/seams horizontally across their image, reproducing the FRONT deck orientation. With a quarter-turn camera the same long boards should run into depth and their seams/grain should recede toward the rear of those side panels. These are drawn board boundaries as well as grain; rotation consistency is not established.
Chunky four-corner structure, substantial deck, open X-braced faces and centered empty circular metal socket on square blue collar are legible. No roof/room/weapon or unsupported floating apparatus.

Centered front step remains on front side; orange toolbox/handle belongs to right side; blue supply crate belongs to rear. Rear crate can be occluded by frame/deck in other elevations; no duplicated box on the wrong face was established.
All six whole objects and relevant ledges are within panel bounds with generous margins and readable labels. The TOP socket interior and contact points are readable.

mandatory_defects_remaining.repair: Re-render only the deck-top plank orientation in the RIGHT and LEFT panels so existing board long axes rotate into depth, consistent with TOP/FRONT/THREE-QUARTER. Keep the socket centered, all four posts/braces, front step, right toolbox/handle, rear crate, materials, framing and labels intact. Do not replace the whole platform design.

preserve: approved materials, empty socket and readable six-panel layout
